items.scale: 2,400 TEUs imported annually via Long Beach and Savannah
items.challenge: Manual tracking through forwarder emails left cold-chain containers vulnerable to terminal dwell, risking spoilage and demurrage penalties during coastal port congestions.
items.solution: Deployed Cargoline automated milestone feeds with temperature telemetry webhooks and early container discharge notifications directly integrated with NetSuite ERP.
items.operationalGain: Zero lost refrigerated loads over 18 operating months and elimination of unexpected terminal demurrage through automated pickup scheduling.

items.scale: 4,100 TEUs imported annually across 14 Asian manufacturing origins
items.challenge: Inventory planning teams lacked visibility into transshipment rail connections, causing stockouts at regional distribution centers and emergency air freight expedites.
items.solution: Implemented Cargoline intermodal rail milestone stitching and automated purchase order line reconciliation against ocean bills of lading.
items.operationalGain: Operations managers now view unified container-to-chassis milestone timelines, enabling accurate warehouse labour scheduling 4 days prior to gate arrival.

items.scale: 1,800 TEUs imported through East Coast ports
items.challenge: Finance department spent 12 hours weekly auditing complex carrier detention invoices against disjointed forwarder delivery receipts.
items.solution: Adopted Cargoline Demurrage Risk Ledger, tracking free-time clocks against real-time vessel discharge timestamps with automated invoice dispute documentation.
items.operationalGain: Finance and operations share a single audit trail of terminal gate-out timestamps, reducing invoice reconciliation time from hours to minutes.
